detail.longDescription: A hacker broke into # JohnDeere and # SharkNinja with an army of # AIagents Researchers at Norforge uncovered attacks through exposed work on Cairn, # AI platform that describes itself as “general-purpose problem-solving engine.” With Cairn, users set start and end point for AI agents, which document progress as they move forward with the task. However, as noted by Norforge, hackers can also use the tool to orchestrate # cyberattacks using AI agents. https://www. theverge.com/ai-artificial-int elligence/1013643/ai-agents-hack-john-deere-shark-ninja-cummins https:// archive.ph/pYmlC
